product_launches.description: Huspy, a leading homebuying technology platform in the UAE, has launched the GCC's first AI-powered mortgage chatbot on WhatsApp during Dubai AI Week 2025. This chatbot provides users with real-time mortgage comparisons, tailored eligibility assessments, and guidance on required documentation, enhancing transparency and efficiency in the homebuying process.

overview_description.description: Huspy provides a platform that simplifies the home buying process, offering services for both mortgages and property acquisition. It helps users find suitable mortgage rates and access a range of properties, from off-plan to move-in ready. Huspy aims to guide clients through the entire process, from mortgage pre-approval to disbursal.

about_short_description.short_description: Huspy is a proptech company that streamlines property search, mortgage comparison, and agent tools for home buyers.

product.name: Mortgage Services
product.description: Provides tailored mortgage options and guidance through the mortgage process from pre-approval to disbursal, including access to mortgage rates and fast-track mortgage approvals.

product.name: Property Search and Listings
product.description: Provides a platform to search for residential properties including off-plan and ready-to-move-in homes, with listings supported by professional photos and videos.

product.name: Property Listing Service for Sellers
product.description: Offers property owners a service to list their properties with professional photo and video shoots and placement on major property portals to increase visibility.

product.name: Mortgage Calculators and Affordability Tools
product.description: Online calculators that help users estimate mortgage payments and assess affordability based on their financial situation.

product.name: Commercial Mortgage Services
product.description: Provides mortgage solutions tailored for commercial property financing needs.
